name: NEN — Dutch Normalisation Institute Construction Standards
description: Validates specifications and BOQ items against key NEN (Nederlands Normalisatie-instituut) construction standards. Covers NEN 6700-series (structural safety, now superseded by Eurocode national annexes), NEN 2580 (floor area measurement, GBO/BVO), NEN 2767 (condition assessment), NEN-EN 1990-1999 (Eurocodes with Dutch National Annexes), and NEN 7120 / NTA 8800 (energy performance). Checks that specification clauses reference applicable NEN standards.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
